_doc: One-shot powers bought at the Sanctum (owner round 2, R2.3). Read by js/sim/powers.js. Buying a power casts it at once at the chosen point (command `power {id, x, z}`); there is no income from powers. `kind` decides where the point may be: defensive = inside your own team's field, offensive = inside an enemy field, neutral = inside any field. `cost` is the main limit; `cooldown` (s, per player per power) is short. Usable while your hero is dead. `effects` run in order; each `do` has a handler in powers.js EFFECTS: zone {radius, seconds, slow?, perSecond?, dmgType?} lingering area hurting/slowing the caster's enemies; status {who, radius, status, seconds, power?} (who: enemies | enemyHeroes | allyHeroes | ownUnits); heal {who, radius, pct of max health}; barrier {who, radius, pct, seconds}; blast {radius, amount, pctMaxHp, dmgType, delay s} on enemies; summon {unit, count, mk (health and damage multiplier)} as the caster's own units; reveal {radius, seconds} shows stealthed units. `name/desc/statLines` are player-facing.

frost_field.name: Frost Field
frost_field.desc: Biting ice spreads over the ground: every enemy that walks through it is slowed and frozen raw.
statLines: 80 nature damage per second to enemies inside

binding_roots.name: Binding Roots
binding_roots.desc: Roots burst from the ground and hold every enemy in place.

mending_light.name: Mending Light
mending_light.desc: A column of warm light heals your heroes and keeps healing them.

stone_ward.name: Stone Ward
stone_ward.desc: A shell of stone forms around your heroes and soaks damage.
statLines: Shield of 30% of max health for 10 s

skyfall.name: Skyfall
skyfall.desc: A burning rock falls on the enemy after a short warning.
statLines: 150 fire damage + 15% of the target's max health

withering_hex.name: Withering Hex
withering_hex.desc: Curses enemy heroes: they take more damage and drag their feet.

loose_the_pack.name: Loose the Pack
loose_the_pack.desc: Unleash a pack of wolves into the enemy field. They fight for you but pay no income and no bounty.
statLines: Each wolf 8x as strong as a hired one

war_banner.name: War Banner
war_banner.desc: Plant a banner among your attacking units: they hit harder and move faster.

far_sight.name: Far Sight
far_sight.desc: Reveals hidden units in an area so heroes can see and strike them.

thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
thunderstorm.desc: A storm cloud lashes your enemies with lightning wherever you put it.
statLines: 60 nature damage per second to enemies

earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
earthshaker.desc: The ground heaves and knocks every enemy off its feet.

blessing_of_valour.name: Blessing of Valour
blessing_of_valour.desc: Your heroes in the area fight harder and move faster for a while.
